_about: Data-sound events of the C5 picture of Tập 2 (frame at 30 fps where each sound starts), from the picture anchors (animatic/src/anchors, resolved on animatic/timing.json) by audio_src/events.py. bar: f0..f1 growth, value = one pitch scale for the film (0..1 -> MIDI 36..60; red shares as 0.3 + share); line: every frame of a draw or a slide (slope at the tip; wobble = the variable path crossing the 9% line); dot: frame it appears, y on screen. Palette S2 "minimal" (sổ gu G-005 · chọn), as Tập 1.
